output.title: Bright 1-Bedroom Apartment with South-Facing Living Room in Bonnevoie
output.description:
This 52 m² apartment offers a well-maintained living space situated in the vibrant Bonnevoie neighborhood. The south-facing living room receives ample natural light through a single window, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere enhanced by laminate flooring and neutral white walls.

The compact kitchen features a practical galley layout with traditional white cabinetry and ceramic tile flooring, providing a functional space suitable for daily meal preparation. Adjoining the living areas, the kitchen's straightforward design accommodates essential cooking needs.

The bathroom includes a full-size shower-tub combination, complemented by white tiled walls and a single vanity unit, maintaining a clean and functional environment. Additional storage needs are served by a separate cellar, located within the building's basement.

Situated near Luxembourg's central station, Bonnevoie is known for its multicultural ambiance and lively market, offering a variety of dining options and convenient access to public transit connections. The apartment benefits from the neighborhood's central location with competitive pricing relative to nearby areas.

Overall, this property presents a practical and comfortable living solution with well-defined spaces and access to the amenities of a dynamic urban setting.

Located in Bonnevoie near central station
